description: This file defines a React-like component called NoteList that renders a list of notes with functionalities for selection and deletion. It includes helper functions for date formatting and content excerpting, and handles user interactions.

methods.name: onDelete
methods.description: Handles the deletion of a note by invoking the onDelete$ callback with the note's ID.

methods.name: formatDate
methods.description: Formats an ISO date string into a medium date and short time format, with error handling.

methods.name: excerpt
methods.description: Creates a shortened preview of the note content up to a specified length.
